description.value: A McDonald's fast food restaurant on Beacon Avenue in Sidney, on the Saanich Peninsula — a well-traveled cycling corridor leading to BC Ferries' Swartz Bay terminal. The location includes a drive-through and is tagged as wheelchair accessible. As a familiar chain anchor on a busy touring route, it offers a reliable food and beverage stop for cyclists passing through.

OSM tags (takeaway=yes, drive_through=yes, internet_access=wlan, wheelchair=yes) are noted but OSM amenity tags are not treated as authoritative without website corroboration.
